title: Set conventions.sourceDirs to web/src and src
goal: check:conventions reads the Angular app in web/src by configuration instead of guessing src/
acceptance: npm run check:conventions reads web/src and passes; every real failure in web/src is fixed per docs/agents/angular.md
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, endpoints or personal data in Git.
escalation: A convention rule that is wrong for NERV goes to the owner instead of an override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one setting plus fixing whatever the check then reports in nine app files. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-26.
